fact: Customs says the SYDONIA World platform is used by Chad customs, and Cameroon's CAMCIS is to be made interoperable with it.
The Chad customs directorate (DGDDI) says SYDONIA World was officially put into service on 15 October 2022, replacing SYDONIA++ in use since 2001.
Chad's customs directorate opened an evaluation workshop on 22 April 2025 for the SYDONIA World automated system, which it says was put in place two years earlier under the PAGESE project.
Chad's customs director general said Chad's customs uses SYDONIA World, which Chad and Cameroon plan to interconnect with Cameroon's CAMCIS.
Chad's customs directorate says its SYDONIA World system processes declarations, with e-payment of all duties and taxes linked to it since 21 February 2024.
